shortInfo: GSL has announced notification for Technical Assistant, EOT Crane Operator posts. Required qualification: PG Diploma, Any Graduate, 10TH, ITI, Diploma, B.Sc. Last date to apply: 27-11-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website www.goashipyard.in and navigate to Notice Board – Careers – Advertisement.
Click on ‘GSL Careers’ and then click the ‘Apply Online’ button.
Select the post you wish to apply for and read the eligibility criteria and Terms & Conditions carefully.

Keep scanned copies (JPG/PDF) of required documents ready: passport size photo, signature, SSC certificate, educational qualification marksheets/degree, caste/disability/ex-serviceman certificate, experience certificates, and Aadhar Card.
Fill in the Online Application Form with all required personal and educational details.
Pay the application fee of ₹200/- (Non-Refundable) online through SBI e-pay (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen are exempted from fee payment.
After successful payment, download and print the Fee Receipt.
After completing the online application, take a printout of the auto-generated filled-in Application Form for use in subsequent selection processes.
Online Application opens from 00.00 hrs on 28.10.2026 and closes at 17.00 hrs on 27.11.2026.
Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.

howToApply: Visit the MRPL website at https://www.mrpl.co.in/careers and click on ‘Advt. No. MRPL/PFTE/2026/02: Engagement of Personnel on Fixed Term Employment’.
Click on ‘Click here to register online’ to generate Login ID and Password.
Sign in using the generated Login ID and Password and fill in the online application form with correct details including educational qualifications, caste, and other required information.
Upload scanned copies of required documents: recent passport size photograph, signature, educational credentials, work experience documents, caste/PwBD/EWS certificate as applicable.
Upon submission, the system will generate an Application ID sent via email/SMS.

General, OBC(NCL) and EWS candidates: Click ‘Pay Now’, select payment category as ‘Advt. No. MRPL/PFTE/2026/02’, and pay application fee of ₹118/- online. Save and upload the payment confirmation receipt. Then click ‘Already Paid’, sign in, submit SBI eCollect Reference Number, Payment Bank Name and Payment Date, upload receipt, and click ‘Next’. Then upload all required documents and click ‘Submit’.
SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates: Directly upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, educational credentials, work experience documents and other required documents, then click ‘Submit’.
Save the PDF of the submitted online application form for future reference. Do not send the printout to MRPL unless specifically asked.
